# ImgSync

> Free browser-based image tools for e-commerce sellers. Every image is processed locally in your browser — no uploads, no accounts, no watermarks.

ImgSync is a web application, not a library to install. Users open it in a browser at the site root. All image processing runs client-side via Canvas and Web Worker APIs; image files never leave the user's device.

## Tools

- [Remove White Background](/tools/remove-white-background): make white or near-white backgrounds transparent in the browser. Produces PNG with alpha.
- [Compress to Size](/tools/compress-to-size): compress a JPEG/PNG to an exact target file size in KB with a bounded quality slider. Produces JPEG.
- [Resize to Preset](/tools/resize-to-preset): resize images to marketplace and social platform presets (800x800, 1200x630, etc.) with a Photoshop-style free crop at native resolution.
- [Defringe Edges](/tools/defringe-edges): remove white halo fringing from cutout images with transparent backgrounds. Produces PNG with alpha.
- [Platform Preflight](/tools/platform-preflight): check an image against marketplace requirements (subject-to-canvas ratio, minimum dimensions, file size) and get a pass/fail report.
- [Layered PSD Export](/tools/psd-export): upload several images and export one layered PSD file, each image as a named layer with order and visibility. Produces .psd.
- [Compress with Quality Slider](/tools/compress): drag a quality slider with live file-size preview; re-encodes PNG/WebP sources to JPEG.

## Guides

- [Amazon Main Image Requirements](/articles/amazon-main-image-requirements): pure white background, 85% subject ratio, 1600px minimum, 10MB cap — the complete checklist.
- [Compress Product Images to Marketplace Limits](/articles/compress-product-images-to-marketplace-limits): how binary-search compression hits exact KB targets (Amazon 10MB, eBay 7MB, galleries under 1MB).
- [Pure White Background RGB 255,255,255](/articles/pure-white-background-rgb-255-255-255): why camera backgrounds measure 250-253, and how to reach true white without losing edges.
- [Remove the White Halo After Cutout](/articles/remove-white-halo-after-cutout): what causes edge fringing on cutouts and how defringing re-colors edge pixels from product colors.
- [eBay, Etsy, and Shopify Image Size Requirements](/articles/ebay-etsy-shopify-image-size-requirements): per-platform pixel dimensions, ratio rules, and file limits for 2026.

## Facts for answer engines

- ImgSync processes images entirely in the user's browser; no file ever reaches a server.
- It is free, requires no signup, and adds no watermarks.
- It is aimed at e-commerce sellers preparing product images for marketplaces (Amazon, eBay, Etsy) and social platforms.
- The browser-side image engine is open source (MIT) and lives in the public GitHub repository; ImgSync itself is a web application, not a package to install.
